docs(audits): FIX-1180 / FIX-1181 — the anon-vs-authenticated cancel split for get_official_page; how two service_role RPCs ran past 8s

stopped_items: Item 2 (the FIX-1181 SET LOCAL fix + check:timeout-scope guard) was not built. This is the prompt's own conditional branch, not a blockage: D3's classification found no session-scoped SET statement_timeout on any PostgREST path, so there was nothing to make LOCAL and a lexical guard would have guarded an empty set. Every such site in the repo is on a pg.Client the code constructs and closes itself.

Read 6's sanctioned probe re-measurement could not run. public._fix1128_probe_sleep no longer exists on prod — pg_proc returns no row for it, in the same query that returned all three other functions, so this is absence rather than a failed read. Nothing was created to replace it; the 2026-09-13 bounds table remains the only measured calibration, and section 4 leans on it.

D2's 'run over the longest window the API keeps' could not be run as written. The Logs API silently answers a >24h window from the day containing the window START and ignores the end, so the literal instruction returns day 1 of 7 while looking like 7 days. Walked four epoch-aligned 24h windows instead and summed them; the census now refuses the shape that would have produced the wrong number.
